evidence.residual_shape: one class only: the same 4 PRs (1498, 1514, 1540, 1569) in every snapshot, recorded NEED_EVIDENCE vs replay CANDIDATE
evidence.mechanism_confirmed: live API read 2026-10-31: all 4 PRs have base.ref != master (master-staging x3, cue/swarms-research-remote-20261021 x1); classify_pr maps base != master to NEED_EVIDENCE, and base.ref is one of the two fields the pr-lane-feed/v1 projection drops (with mergeable_state). The replay gap is the feed projection, not the classifier and not the harness.
evidence.extract_supersede_exact: EXTRACT and SUPERSEDE counts reproduce exactly in all 7 snapshots after the harness fix below.

harness_finding.bug: First replay run produced 3 false mismatches (PRs 125/143/390, recorded EXTRACT vs replay SUPERSEDE): the reconstruction omitted user={login}, and minesweeper_rules.is_bot_author only falls back to the author field when user is NOT a dict — an empty/absent user silently disables bot detection. All 3 PRs are google-labs-jules[bot] with changed_files > 40 (minesweeper EXTRACT).
harness_finding.fix: prlane_replay.reconstruct now sets user={login: author}, mirroring production build_pr_dict. Lesson recorded: replay reconstructions must mirror the producer's dict shape exactly, including nested fields with fallback traps.

consequences.known_gap_class: recorded NEED_EVIDENCE + replay CANDIDATE + gates pass + not draft = dropped-field NE (base or mergeable_state); identifiable in every later phase, never counted as a tuning effect.
consequences.ask_to_steward: pr-lane-feed v1.1: carry base.ref and mergeable_state per row — with those two fields the replay becomes exact and the gap class disappears.
